cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags

cards.body: Leaders: BE +7.33%, OKLO +7.01%, PWR +6.36%, EOSE +6.30%, TLN +5.77%. Laggards: DUK -0.97%, NEE -0.81%, ETR -0.56%, MPLX -0.19%.
